public: On 3 November 2021 France submitted draft S/2021/913. The Council adopted it 15–0–0 as resolution 2604 (2021). Under Chapter VII it authorized Member States acting through or in cooperation with the EU to continue EUFOR ALTHEA for twelve months. The adopted text has six operative paragraphs on military authorization and remaining seized. It contains no decision appointing or removing a High Representative or deciding the status of that civilian office.

desks.United Kingdom: Ms Farrey welcomed the twelve-month EUFOR renewal for stabilizing the country and enabling the civilian work of the High Representative. She backed Christian Schmidt as High Representative, supported his use of executive powers if needed, and opposed closing the office prematurely. She said closure still required completing the 5+2 agenda and urged Bosnia and Herzegovina's authorities to work toward it.
desks.Russian Federation: Mr Nebenzia argued that Christian Schmidt had been appointed by circumventing the Council and the practice of consensus and therefore maintained, as the Russian position, that the High Representative post remained vacant. He argued that the Office undermined Dayton and that reconciliation required dialogue among Bosnians free of outside interference, with responsibility resting with elected authorities. Russia was among the fifteen Council members voting for the draft.
